authorization: User explicitly requests removing optimizations at the wrong abstraction layer and consolidating shared algorithms through nominal owners.
domain: Store-bound derived measurement queries and provider-independent dense object measurement columns.

determining_owners.bounded_lookup_and_retention: BoundedCache, extracted from the existing storage algorithm; ProcessLocalBoundedCache retains only process singleton lifetime policy
determining_owners.store_query_domains: RuntimeObjectLabelMeasurementQueryCache and RuntimeMeasurementTablesQueryCache derive from BoundedCache without process singleton APIs

required_pairs: Store.record/replace/clear/merge_observed_values invalidate all attached query caches through _mark_mutated.
Generic measurement table lookup and CellProfiler label/vector consumers use store.query_cache.
Concrete cache subclasses select domain and key/value types; existing parent owns bounded storage, lookup and clearing.
All six numerical column providers inherit the existing object columnar owner in core.
Shared mapping iteration belongs to that object-column parent; typed leaf iteration remains leaf-owned.
Store-owned query domains do not inherit process-global singleton policy.
forbidden_pairs: Provider modules own weak-global store revision caches.
Generic artifact consumers duplicate revision invalidation logic.
Numerical providers import generic row behavior from another provider module.
Unused long-row conversion or behavior-only forwarding subclasses remain.
counterevidence: LongObjectMeasurementColumnarRows.__iter__ is shadowed by all three current children; those children declare wide feature columns, so moving its dead conversion loop would perpetuate an incorrect role.
WideObjectMeasurementColumnarRows only adds generic mapping iteration; its two children now inherit that behavior from their actual object-column ancestor.
Numerical kernel caches, CP feature naming and CP relationship interpretation have intrinsic/provider meaning and remain at those owners.
No speedup is claimed for lifecycle relocation. Column CSV prototype saves only 0.19s and is rejected as a primary runtime fix.
Saved measurement provenance replay costs15.9s but is not yet demonstrated in the live CP path; no production payoff is inferred.
proof_limits: Authored exact replacements: NRA revision/syntax checks do not prove native semantic equivalence.
Module deletion lacks NRA file-deletion primitive; emptying is revision checked and the empty owned file is then removed with an explicit assertion.
Removal of obsolete provider class import paths is intentional; external dynamic/pickle callers of those abstract classes remain OPEN.
Query cache capacity changes from unbounded dictionaries to existing bounded LRU; misses recompute. Derived caches must be excluded from serialization.
Current query IDs retain all existing axis/group/source/label-plane/domain scopes; the change does not add a new cross-dialect caller.
